import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MazeSolver {
    static char[][] mazeA = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] mazeB = new char[12][12];
    static int dimension, maxTime;
    static boolean[][][][][] visitedStates = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] canReachState = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] timeMap = new int[12][12];

    static void exploreStates(int step, int x, int y, int originX, int originY) {
        if (maxTime >= 70 || x < 0 || x >= dimension || y < 0 || y >= dimension)
            return;
        if (mazeA[x][y] < '0' || mazeA[x][y] > '9')
            return;
        if (step > maxTime + 1)
            return;
        if (visitedStates[step][x][y][originX][originY])
            return;
        if (timeMap[x][y] != 0 && step > timeMap[x][y])
            return;
        if (timeMap[x][y] == step && (mazeB[x][y] > '9' || mazeB[x][y] <= '0'))
            return;
        visitedStates[step][x][y][originX][originY] = true;

        if (step < timeMap[x][y]) {
            exploreStates(step + 1, x, y, originX, originY);
            exploreStates(step + 1, x + 1, y, originX, originY);
            exploreStates(step + 1, x - 1, y, originX, originY);
            exploreStates(step + 1, x, y + 1, originX, originY);
            exploreStates(step + 1, x, y - 1, originX, originY);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mazeA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mazeB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] E = new int[210];
        int[] H = new int[210];
        int[][] C = new int[210][210];
        int[][] pN = new int[11][11];

        for (int[] row : C)
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);
        for (int[] row : pN)
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);

        for (int[] row : visitedStates)
            for (boolean[][][] arr3 : row)
                for (boolean[][] arr2 : arr3)
                    for (boolean[] arr1 : arr2)
                        Arrays.fill(arr1, false);

        int[][] directions = {{-1,0},{0,-1},{1,0},{0,1}};
        int[][] timeMapLocal = new int[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(timeMapLocal[i], -1);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (mazeA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    timeMapLocal[i][j] = 0;
                    q.offer(new int[]{i,j});
                }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int pi = p[0], pj = p[1];
            if (timeMapLocal[pi][pj] >= t) continue;
            for (int[] d : directions) {
                int ni = pi + d[0], nj = pj + d[1];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && mazeA[ni][nj] >= '0' && mazeA[ni][nj] <= '9' && timeMapLocal[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    timeMapLocal[ni][nj] = timeMapLocal[pi][pj] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (timeMapLocal[i][j] == -1)
                    timeMapLocal[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (mazeA[i][j] >= '0' && mazeA[i][j] <= '9')
                    exploreStates(0, i, j, i, j);

        List<Integer> startNodes = new ArrayList<>();
        graph.add(startNodes);

        boolean[][][][] canReach = new boolean[n][n][n][n];
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                        for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; nt++) {
                            canReach[i1][j1][i2][j2] |= visitedStates[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                if (mazeA[i1][j1] > '0' && mazeA[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int k = graph.size();
                    List<Integer> g = new ArrayList<>();
                    graph.add(g);
                    E[k] = mazeA[i1][j1] - '0';

                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                            if (mazeB[i2][j2] > '0' && mazeB[i2][j2] <= '9') {
                                if (canReach[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (pN[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                        List<Integer> _g = new ArrayList<>();
                                        _k = graph.size();
                                        graph.add(_g);
                                        pN[i2][j2] = _k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k = pN[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    graph.get(k).add(_k);
                                    graph.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                    C[_k][k] = 0;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                if (mazeB[i2][j2] > '0' && mazeB[i2][j2] <= '9' && pN[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = pN[i2][j2];
                    graph.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = mazeB[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        int size = graph.size();
        int[] EArr = E;
        int[] HArr = H;
        int[][] CArr = C;
        int[] F = new int[size * size]; // flatten for simplicity
        int[] Hs = new int[size];
        int[] Evals = new int[size];

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            Evals[i] = EArr[i];
            Hs[i] = 0;
        }

        boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[size];
        boolean allDone;

        do {
            allDone = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
                while (Evals[i] > 0) {
                    boolean progressFlag = true;
                    int minH = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int neighbor : graph.get(i)) {
                        int capacity = CArr[i][neighbor];
                        if (capacity - Evals[i] > 0 && Hs[i] == Hs[neighbor] + 1) {
                            int delta = Math.min(capacity - Evals[i], Evals[i]);
                            int index1 = i * size + neighbor;
                            int index2 = neighbor * size + i;
                            F[index1] += delta;
                            F[index2] -= delta;
                            Evals[i] -= delta;
                            Evals[neighbor] += delta;
                            progressFlag = false;
                            allDone = false;
                            if (Evals[i] == 0) break;
                        }
                        minH = Math.min(minH, Hs[neighbor]);
                    }
                    if (Hs[i] != minH + 1 && minH != Integer.MAX_VALUE)
                        Hs[i] = minH + 1;
                    if (progressFlag) break;
                }
            }
        } while (!allDone);

        System.out.println(Evals[0]);
    }
}
